title: "Daily Translation: A Parcel Locker That Would Not Open"

date: "2026-10-17"
categories: [English Learning, Daily Translation]
---

## 中文原文
今天下午你收到快递短信，去小区快递柜取包裹。输入取件码之后柜子打不开。你联系快递客服，客服帮你远程解锁，最后成功拿到包裹。

## My translation
In today's afternoon, I received delivery messages and went to pick up my packages at the delivery cabinet.
I couldn't open the cabinet even I entered the pick-up code.
So I contacted the delivery receptionists, then they helped me unlock the cabinet remotely.
Finally, I got my package.

## Revised version
This afternoon, I received a delivery notification and went to collect my package at the parcel locker.
I couldn't open the locker even though I entered the pickup code.
I contacted the delivery customer service, and they unlocked the locker for me remotely.
I finally got my package.

## Key phrases
- delivery notification
- collect my package
- parcel locker，快递柜
- pickup code，取件码
- delivery customer service，快递客服
